friction_section.title: The Friction Point
friction_section.subtitle: Mechanics and auto repair shops manage urgent customer calls, service bookings, vehicle diagnostics, estimate approvals, parts updates, and manual follow-ups that can slow daily operations.

cards.title: Manual Booking and Call Handling
cards.description: Oil changes, brake repairs, diagnostics, MOT checks, inspections, tire services, and emergency repair requests often depend on constant phone calls and manual scheduling.

cards.title: Disconnected Repair Information
cards.description: Customer details, vehicle history, repair notes, estimate approvals, parts status, and service reminders are often spread across separate systems.

cards.title: Missed Service Revenue
cards.description: Without automated reminders and follow-ups, garages lose repeat business from maintenance schedules, inspection renewals, tire changes, and recommended repairs.
